value.title: Output answer authority gate closure

sections.name: body
sections.value:
This records closure of PR #137 S001 at 1fbe46c4ab695d0f43b3e8e65b189fa68ac8fb26, updating the earlier output-publication-and-answer-authority note for blocked 4ab6460.

Answer authorization is resolved from the stored request: its recorded holder, a live caller holding its project/role, or its projects.prime_id. The output's declared context, holder flag, project creator, parent and native PM designation are not substitutes.

The gate runs before output_add, indexing, answer stamping and notification. CI now refuses the former unauthorized creator with unchanged commit, absent index/stamp and no notice, while still allowing flagged publication without --answers. The recorded-holder case is independently proved without a current assignment; live-holder and project-prime cases also pass.

Storage now keys facts by project + path, retaining identical relative paths in different projects. Notice IDs derive from project + output commit, not a clock. The validated project slug and hyphen-free Git suffix make the ID composition unambiguous. Concurrent notice coverage retains two distinct FYIs.

Notification lookup/refusal causes remain explicit in notified.outcome. A command may successfully commit an output while notification fails; that is neither notice delivery nor model completion. Shared audit-before-dispatch failure braking remains, but output-specific injected failures and concurrent authority revocation were not independently exercised.

Output/outputs are native-forwarded with argv/stdin unchanged and native body-file reading. Caller fields remain logical claims under machine-wide bearer authority, with PID/start absent, not cryptographic per-seat attestation.

CI run 42224735209 tested an identical whole tree and reports 2021 passing Rust cases. Fake/unavailable ddocs and unproved external-link renderer behavior remain limits. No local output, notification or payload operation was performed.

The final answer preserved original-request correlation with --in-reply-to. Receipt acceptance is not model completion or independent clock-state verification.
